guarded_ordered_transitions.semantics: cmdAdd sorts each input dataList ascending, finds same-time duplicate indexes from first signal only and splices those indexes out of every signal. Finds first first-signal time>last saved first-signal time (fallback0), drops common older prefix from all signals. First batch sets bufferedStartTime; bufferedLastTime is last newly accepted first-signal sample. If total duration>2.8h, scans existing first signal for old prefix and slices every saved signal by common count. Deep-copy incoming signal, concatenate by signalDataIndexMap or append new signal and map. Source mutates caller arrays before deep-copy.

cmdSave deep-copies metadata. SAVE_SETTING truthy deletes triggerInfoList via undefined; saveType2 selects last-window,3 flag-window,any other all. No SAVE_SETTING -> trigger-window type1. All variants call inherited divideSaveToPlatform(saveData) without returning that call/promise.

All: each signal emits seqNumber1..N skipping falsy samples, recordTime=time-thatSignal.first.time; shared timeMap associates actual time->seq. Flags renumber1.. and map timeMap[flag.recordTime], normalize by first saved signal first.time, retain memo/isPopup.

Last: firstTime=max(0,last.firstSignal.time-saveTime1), firstPos first sample>=firstTime, startTime its actual time; slice all signal indexes[firstPos..end], seq reset1 per signal, recordTime=time-startTime. Filter flags >=startTime, renumber and map sequences. Defaults firstPos/startTime0 persist if no matching sample.

Flag: requires first/last flag. Desired window firstFlag.time-saveTime2 bounded0 through lastFlag.time+saveTime2; find first>=start and last<=end on first signal. If end-start>=2.8h, move start forward to first sample>=end-2.8h. Emit inclusive[firstPos,lastPos] per signal, retain flags between actual start/end inclusive, normalize times/renumber/sequences. Does not add special empty-flag fallback.

Type1: triggerTime from triggerInfoList[0], before=DURATION*TRIGGER_POINT, after=DURATION-before. Locate first first-signal sample>=triggerTime, snap trigger time. If found, choose earliest pretrigger sample within before range, emit pretrigger frames, common trigger frame and posttrigger up to after range. Offset every trigger seq/time by first trigger difference to actual trigger; same offsets for flags without filtering or renumbering. signalIdMap reused for each signal; when trigger not found forwards saveData without constructed signalDataList rather than synthesizing success content.

request_construction.semantics: Only outbound handoff is inherited divideSaveToPlatform(saveData); port,path,memo/platform chunking stay shared GtsBaseBuffer owner. Config setter stores supplied object by reference, no conversion.

response_error_mapping.semantics: cmdAdd returns resolved promises in all normal branches. cmdSave has no catch and no explicit return; invalid or absent config/data/required flags/triggers may throw naturally. No assertion of platform completion can be inferred from cmdSave return.

user_visible_result.semantics: Serialized snapshot signal streams use relative recordTime and monotonic seqNumber with attached flags/triggers; no UI rendered by buffer.

mutation_cleanup_cancel.semantics: initBuffer replaces lists/map and bufferedLastTime0; duration clipping removes oldest stored prefix, not all latest data. Saving deep-copies metadata but does not clear buffer here; worker separately issues buffer.clear concurrently with save/config.
